{{nihongo|'''Korizu Shrine'''|郡頭神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Tosa Province]].

=== Founding ===
The founding date is unknown{{Sfn|郡頭神社（式内社）|1987}}. In the '{{ill|Shoku Nihongi|Q611399|qid=Q611399}}' entry for {{ill|Jingo-keiun|de|Jingo-Keiun|es|Jingo-keiun|fa|جینگو-کیئون|fr|Ère Jingo-keiun|ia|Jingo-keiun|id|Jingo-keiun|ja|神護景雲|ko|진고케이운|ru|Дзинго-кэйун|simple|Jingo-keiun|sr|Џинго кеиун|tr|Jingo-keiun|uk|Дзінґо Кей'ун|zh|神護景雲|zh_yue|神護景雲|qid=Q1373049}} 2 ({{ill|768|ab|768|af|768|als|768|am|768 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|768|ar|768|ary|768|arz|768|ast|768|avk|768|az|768|azb|۷۶۸ (میلادی)|bar|768|be|768|be_x_old|768|bg|768|bn|৭৬৮|bpy|মারি ৭৬৮|br|768|bs|768.|ca|768|cdo|768 nièng|ceb|768|ckb|٧٦٨|crh|768|cs|768|cv|768|cy|768|da|768|de|768|el|768|eml|768|eo|768|es|768|et|768|eu|768|fa|۷۶۸ (میلادی)|fi|768|fo|768|fr|768|fy|768|ga|768|gan|768年|gd|768|gl|768|he|768|hi|768|hr|768.|ht|768 (almanak jilyen)|hu|768|hy|768|id|768|io|768|is|768|it|768|ja|768年|jv|768|ka|768|kaa|768|kk|768 жыл|ko|768년|la|768|lb|768|lij|768|lmo|768|lt|768 m.|map_bms|768|mdf|768|mg|768|mhr|768|mk|768|mr|इ.स. ७६८|mrj|768 и|ms|768|mzn|۷۶۸|nah|768|nap|768|nds|768|new|सन् ७६८|nl|768|nn|768|no|768|nrm|768|nso|768|oc|768|or|୭୬୮|os|768-æм аз|pl|768|pnb|768|pt|768|qu|768|ro|768|ru|768 год|rue|768|sa|७६८|scn|768|sd|768ع|sh|768.|shn|768|si|768|sk|768|sl|768|sq|768|sr|768|su|768|sv|768|sw|768|tg|Соли 768|th|พ.ศ. 1311|tk|768|tl|768|tly|768|tr|768|tt|768 ел|uk|768|ur|768ء|uz|768|vec|768|vi|768|vls|768|war|768|wuu|768年|xmf|768|zh|768年|zh_min_nan|768 nî|zh_yue|768年|qid=Q29961}}), 11th month, 18th day, it records that 41 people including Kamiyoda no Sukuna from Tosa District, Tosa Province, were granted the surname "{{ill|Kamo no Ason clan|ja|賀茂朝臣氏|qid=Q122979457|lt=Kamo}}"; "Kamiyoda" is said to refer to the nearby place name Kōda{{Sfn|郡頭神社（式内社）|1987}}. Also, in '{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|de|Shinsen Shōjiroku|fr|Shinsen shōjiroku|ja|新撰姓氏録|ko|신찬성씨록|ru|Синсэн сёдзироку|zh|新撰姓氏錄|qid=Q1045362}}' under Settsu Province, divine lineage, Chigi, Kamo-be-hafuri entry, it says: "Kamo-be-hafuri, same ancestor as Kamo no Ason, descendants of Ōkuninushi"{{Sfn|郡頭神社（式内社）|1987}}. From these records, it is said this shrine began when Kamo/Kamobe groups (be-min of the Kamo clan) living around Kamobe enshrined Ōkuninushi as ancestral deity{{Sfn|郡頭神社（式内社）|1987}}{{Sfn|郡頭神社（平凡社）|1983}}.

This area is identified with Kamobe-gō of Tosa District in the '{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Wamyōshō}}'{{Sfn|郡頭神社（式内社）|1987}}. Development of Kamobe-gō is seen as from the {{ill|Kofun period|Q459939|qid=Q459939}}, and primitive rituals are inferred by around the {{ill|6th century|Q8090|qid=Q8090}}{{Sfn|郡頭神社（式内社）|1987}}. Later prosperity is seen in a Tōdaiji document: in {{ill|Tenpyō-shōhō|Q1373169|qid=Q1373169}} 4 ({{ill|752|ab|752|af|752|als|752|am|752 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|752|ar|752|ary|752|ast|752|avk|752|az|752|azb|۷۵۲ (میلادی)|bar|752|be|752|be_x_old|752|bg|752|bn|৭৫২|bpy|মারি ৭৫২|br|752|bs|752.|ca|752|cdo|752 nièng|ceb|752|ckb|٧٥٢|crh|752|cs|752|cv|752|cy|752|da|752|de|752|el|752|eml|752|eo|752|es|752|et|752|eu|752|fa|۷۵۲ (میلادی)|fi|752|fo|752|fr|752|fy|752|ga|752|gan|752年|gd|752|gl|752|he|752|hi|752|hr|752.|ht|752 (almanak jilyen)|hu|752|hy|752|id|752|io|752|is|752|it|752|ja|752年|jv|752|ka|752|kk|752 жыл|ko|752년|la|752|lb|752|lij|752|lmo|752|lt|752 m.|map_bms|752|mdf|752|mg|752|mhr|752|mk|752|mr|इ.स. ७५२|mrj|752 и|ms|752|mzn|۷۵۲|nah|752|nap|752|nds|752|new|सन् ७५२|nl|752|nn|752|no|752|nrm|752|nso|752|oc|752|or|୭୫୨|os|752-æм аз|pl|752|pnb|752|pt|752|qu|752|ro|752|ru|752 год|rue|752|sa|७५२|sah|752|scn|752|sd|752ع|sh|752.|shn|752|si|752|simple|752|sk|752|sl|752|sq|752|sr|752|su|752|sv|752|sw|752|tg|Соли 752|th|พ.ศ. 1295|tk|752|tl|752|tly|752|tr|752|tt|752 ел|uk|752|ur|752ء|uz|752|vec|752|vi|752|war|752|wuu|752年|xmf|752|zh|752年|zh_min_nan|752 nî|zh_yue|752年|qid=Q23639}}), 50 households from Kamobe-gō were assigned as {{ill|Fūko|Q11458391|qid=Q11458391}} of {{ill|Tōdai-ji|Q460367|qid=Q460367}}{{Sfn|郡頭神社（式内社）|1987}}.

The shrine name "Korigashira/Koorizu" has unclear origin: theories include that it stands in Tosa District, the head district of Tosa Province; that district headquarters stood in Kamobe-gō; or that it derives from the place name Kōda{{Sfn|郡頭神社（式内社）|1987}}.

=== Overview history ===
In the '{{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}' {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Jinmyōchō}} compiled in {{ill|Enchō|Q1327274|qid=Q1327274}} 5 ({{ill|927|Q30470|qid=Q30470}}), "Korizu Shrine" is listed in Tosa District, {{ill|Tosa Province|Q857330|qid=Q857330}}, identified with this shrine{{Sfn|郡頭神社（式内社）|1987}}. The reading there is given as "Kohoritsuno"{{Sfn|郡頭神社（式内社）|1987}}.

In {{ill|Shōwa era|Q327567|qid=Q327567}} 56 ({{ill|1981|Q2437|qid=Q2437}}), a fire destroyed the shrine buildings; the current buildings are rebuilt afterward<ref name="説明板"/>.
